info.title: Hotel Operations API — Draft
info.description: Independent planning contract only. No endpoints are implemented. Tableau transport is deferred. Open business items are in research.md and spec.md; no duplicate-creation handling or login is added. Reporting and satisfaction endpoints synchronized with the implemented backend contract on 2026-11-03; backend/openapi.json is authoritative for runtime.

post.description: Record a distinct questionnaire for one room on an active booking, without login. Validate numeric rating 1–5 and current booking-room membership in one transaction serialized with booking edits/cancellation. Each POST is a new actual response, not an overwrite; correction/deduplication policy remains open. No historical ratings generated. Original room linkage persists after booking edits; responses linked to cancelled bookings are excluded from reports.

get.description: Optional year selects occupied nights; bookings count once within each scope, including stays crossing New Year. No year means all years. Cancelled bookings excluded. Prices use saved charges, not today’s tariff. Synthetic dates/room assignments are labelled. Guest count is null if any included booking has unknown guests; known subtotal and unknown booking count remain visible. Annual occupancy is soldRoomNights / (214 × 365) × 100, using the agreed fixed denominator even in leap years; null without nights or without a year. Empty booking/night counts are zero. Bar uses its sales dates and all categories, including walk-ins. Total sums recorded components; null only if both are absent.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Optional calendar year (1000–9999). Omit for all saved years; a repeated or empty value is invalid.

200.description: Current saved results; empty scopes preserve null amounts and unknown counts.

get.summary: Read annual drink units and revenue
get.description: Alias of the drinks array in /api/reports/bar. Requires one year; preserves all source menu items and null amounts without sales.

All-time room questionnaire means and counts; no query parameters allowed. Financial year selection does not apply. Excludes responses linked to cancelled bookings. A recorded response retains its original room if a booking is edited. Null mean with zero responses; arithmetic mean, formatted to one decimal by the UI. No historical ratings are generated.

200.description: Current saved results; empty scopes preserve null amounts and unknown counts.

get.summary: Read annual hotel revenue with room and bar components
get.description: Current saved room and bar revenue for one calendar year. Active room-night charges use each occupied night's year (arrival included, departure excluded), including future booked nights; cancelled bookings are excluded. Bar sales use sales_date and saved exact_revenue, including all categories and walk-in customers. Components are aggregated independently without join multiplication; source reference totals are not added again. No tariff or menu-price recalculation. totalRevenue sums recorded components; a missing component remains null and totalRevenue is null only if neither has records. Recorded zero remains 0.00. Amounts are exact decimal strings, displayed to one decimal in the frontend. containsSyntheticData covers either included source; see /api/reports/history. Reads current data on each request in a single database snapshot. The existing roomRevenue field is retained.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: One four-digit calendar year, within the existing booking API date range.

200.description: Annual combined hotel revenue and distinct components; missing components remain null.

get.summary: Read annual bar revenue, units, category mix and revenue per drink
get.description: Only dated daily sales are included. Source aggregates are allocated to labelled synthetic daily records across 2024–2026. Only the generated daily records contribute to revenue; raw aggregates are not counted a second time. containsSyntheticData identifies these results. Wine/beer contribute to overall totals, but not the cocktail/coffee denominator. No-data values are null. For recorded zero comparison revenue, mixStatus is undefined: no numeric percentage is invented and the outstanding zero-denominator clarification is not marked resolved. Exact DKK strings; frontend displays one decimal.

400.description: Invalid date, drink, quantity or reporting year

get.summary: Read original Excel control totals and demonstration-year allocation
get.description: Immutable original source totals across the complete source horizon. They are reference values, not additional reportable revenue or claimed actual annual history. Operational edits/cancellations affect current reporting without changing this evidence. Dates/assignments are generated; missing person counts remain unknown.
